text:
Mina (Onboarding Lead): Hi team  kicking off PiperRetail onboarding. Aim: pilot storefront in 30 days, handoff day 45. Need owners, concrete success criteria, and any immediate blockers. Who's free for a 25m kickoff tomorrow?

Omar (CSM): Free 11am PT. I'll run weekly health updates and customer comms.

Dev (Solutions Eng): 11am PT works. Need infra contact for IP allowlist/VPC and whether they require private deployment.

Priya - PiperRetail (Customer): 11am works. We prefer starting in hosted sandbox, plan VPC peering later. I'll share infra POC and a labeled prompt set (~9k) before the meeting.

Mina (Onboarding Lead): Draft success criteria: 1) sandbox E2E flow for checkout assistant, 2) acceptance pass on labeled prompts, 3) 95th pct latency <350ms on typical 256-token calls, 4) enablement session recorded + runbook, 5) baseline 30-day DAU target for renewal signals. Any additions?

Hector (Renewals): Add procurement_watch  they mentioned a finance review in ~6 weeks. I'll tag renewal risk = medium.

Zoe (Enablement): I'll prepare quickstart slides + a 30-min recorded training. Recommend live Q&A day 5 after integration.

Dev (Solutions Eng): Tech checklist I'll bring: API key provisioning, sample payloads, model rec (redwood/opt-13b-quant), mini load-test plan. Sanity curl to run after key:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood/test-small","input":"ping"}'
```

Mina (Onboarding Lead): @calendar-bot schedule 25m kickoff tomorrow 14:00 ET / 11:00 PT. Agenda: intros, confirm criteria, infra checklist, milestones & owners.

calendar-bot: Created event "PiperRetail  Onboard Kickoff" for 2026-05-10 14:00 ET. Invitees: Mina, Omar, Dev, Priya, Zoe, Hector.

Priya - PiperRetail (Customer): I'll upload the S3 link for prompts and infra POC before the meeting and confirm VPC timeline.

Mina (Onboarding Lead): Action items recap:
- Priya: infra POC + prompts (before kickoff)
- Dev: tech checklist + mini load-test template (1 day post-kickoff)
- Omar: 30/60/90 health plan + DAU targets (3 days)
- Zoe: enablement pack + recording (day 5)
- Hector: add procurement_watch in CRM

Omar (CSM): I'll also schedule a day-14 pulse survey to capture early feedback.

Mina (Onboarding Lead): Risk note: if Piper requires private deployment immediately timeline may extend ~3 weeks. Priya please confirm by EOD.

Priya - PiperRetail (Customer): We can start sandbox and confirm peering after pilot. See you at kickoff.
